skill_name: Create a 500-word essay on the role of technology in physical education.
workflow: Technology has revolutionized physical education in countless ways, and it continues to do so at an ever-accelerating pace. For starters, technology can provide students with information and feedback regarding their physical performance in the form of data, analytics and measurements that would be impossible to obtain manually.
